---
title: "ScatterPlot regression guard"
format: html
---

## Purpose

`benchmark/ScatterPlotViewInteraction.benchmark.cpp` builds `benchmark_ScatterPlotView`,
a fixed-loop pan/zoom stress binary for `ScatterPlotOpenGLWidget`. It is run under
heaptrack to catch allocation churn when view-only interaction accidentally rebuilds
the scene (the bug class you fixed with ~1000× slowdown).

No library instrumentation. Pass/fail compares heaptrack summary lines to a local baseline.

## Commands

```bash
cmake --preset my-clang-release
cmake --build --preset my-clang-release

# Once per machine:
cmake --build --preset my-clang-release --target record_benchmark_baselines

# After changes:
cmake --build --preset my-clang-release --target check_benchmark_regressions
```

Baselines: `benchmark-baselines-local/` (gitignored). Requires `HEAPTRACK_EXECUTABLE`
in `CMakeUserPresets.json` and working OpenGL on the machine.

## Manual run

```bash
./out/build/Clang/Release/benchmark/benchmark_ScatterPlotView
```

Optional arguments: `point_count` `iteration_count` (defaults: 10000, 50).

## What fails

`check_benchmark_regressions` compares heaptrack summary output. Primary signal:
`temporary allocations` (per-frame churn). Secondary: total `allocations`.
Default tolerance: 30% above baseline.

Inspect detailed stacks with the `.zst` file in `out/build/Clang/Release/benchmark-regression-results/`.
